SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(LEGACY_GR_NO) AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM BOL_PO_KEP_STORAGE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_GR_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'BNGS' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, DELY_TO_LOCATION AS PLANT , REQUNO, LEGACY_PO_NO, INVOICE_NO AS LEGACY_INV_NO, LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , CURRENCY_CODE , PRIMARY_UOM AS UNIT_MEASURE, UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE , LEGACY_PR_NO||'-'||LEGACY_PR_SEQ||'-'||REQUNO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , DELY_TO_LOCATION , RO_QTY , RO_AMT , REMARK FROM BOL_PO_KEP_STORAGE WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE BOL_PO_KEP_STORAGE SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
